product_metadata.title: Cottage Garden Life Would Not Be The Same Black Rope Trim 2 x 3 Tiny Frame with Magnet and Easel
features: Embossed, rope trim borders with raised panel frame; black finish.
Tiny frame measures approximately 5 x 3 inches; Artwork can be replaced with a personal 3 x 2 photo.
It can go almost anywhere with an easel back, ribbon hanger and magnetic backing.
Easel back allows frame to be displayed vertically or horizontally on a table or shelf.
Ships in protective packaging; Ready for giving to that special someone.
description: Cottage Garden inspirational and sentimental products are both lovely and classic in style. Be encouraged by a message that reads, "My life would not be the same without your friendship. " Designed by artists in the Heartland of America, Cottage Garden’s Collections reach a variety of tastes and have a wide range of occasions for gifting. Embossed, rope trim borders with raised panel frame; black finish. Tiny frame measures approximately 5 x 3 inches; Artwork can be replaced with a personal 3 x 2 photo. It can go almost anywhere with an easel back, ribbon hanger and magnetic backing. Easel back allows frame to be displayed vertically or horizontally on a table or shelf. Ships in protective packaging; Ready for giving to that special someone.
